protocol.selection: lowest pooled inner-fold negative Gaussian log density
protocol.basis: mboostrs/R use bbs; mssm uses REML with null-space penalties; bases and penalties differ
protocol.interactions: additive: none; supplied: the product x1*x2 for every method (a term for smooth models, a column for NGBoost with depth-1 trees); discovery: nothing supplied, NGBoost depth-3 trees, smooth models additive
protocol.test_access: after all configuration choices; no response clipping
protocol.warmup: dependency imports only; no repeated fixed-workload timing or speed ratio
protocol.timed_boundary: all inner fits, final refit, prediction and score calculation

uncertainty.unit: one independent training and test draw; pair methods within a draw
uncertainty.summary: mean and Monte Carlo standard error across draws
uncertainty.timing: elapsed whole-workflow costs, not controlled implementation speed ratios
